links.comparator_used: Unfiltered model responses delivered as generated, with no automated evaluator filter
links.outcome: Overall response error rate and presence of harmful responses
links.effect: Reduced overall error rates but did not eliminate harmful responses; no numbers given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Harmful responses persisted. Flagged responses were replaced with a deferral message telling patients to contact their healthcare provider.
links.quote: Applying an automated safety filter reduced overall error rates but failed to eliminate harmful responses.

links.comparator_used: Human rater evaluation, including three medical experts
links.outcome: Agreement between LLM-as-a-judge automatic evaluation and human judgments of response correctness
links.effect: Automatic evaluation results closely aligned with human judgments; no agreement statistic given in the abstract
links.quote: Automatic evaluation results closely aligned with human judgments: leading models approached but did not achieve adequate performance.

design_hint: automated safety filter with provider deferral
